PROCUREMENT POLICY
Policy Code: PRC-001
Title: Purchasing Authority and Approvals
Version: 2.0
Effective Date: 2025-01-01
Category: approvals
Company: Northwind Industrial Co.
1. Scope
1.1 This policy applies to all purchases of goods and services made on behalf of
    Northwind Industrial Co.
1.2 Purchases must be approved before an order is placed with a supplier.
1.3 All amounts in this policy are expressed in USD; purchases in other currencies are
    converted using the treasury rate on the request date.
2. Approval Thresholds
2.1 Purchases up to USD 1,000 may be approved by the department manager.
2.2 Purchases above USD 1,000 and up to USD 10,000 must be approved by a procurement
    officer.
2.3 Purchases above USD 10,000 and up to USD 50,000 must be approved by the finance
    director.
2.4 Purchases above USD 50,000 must be approved by the chief financial officer.
3. Segregation of Duties
3.1 The requester of a purchase must not approve the same purchase.
3.2 Approvers must record written reasoning for every approval or rejection.
SYNTHETIC DATA - fictional company and vendors, not a real document
